title: 哨兵 Raft 式 leader 选举：epoch + 多数派
expected_output:
=== 哨兵 Raft 式 leader 选举模拟 ===
哨兵集合 N=3, 当选需多数派票数 > N/2 = 2
候选 S1 获得票数 = 3
S1 获得多数派(2) -> 当选 leader, 执行故障转移
最终 leader = S1
code:
print("=== 哨兵 Raft 式 leader 选举模拟 ===")
N = 3
majority = N // 2 + 1
print("哨兵集合 N=%d, 当选需多数派票数 > N/2 = %d" % (N, majority))
candidates = ["S1", "S2", "S3"]
votes = {}
leader = None
for c in candidates:
    v = 1
    for other in candidates:
        if other == c:
            continue
        if other not in votes:
            votes[other] = c
            v += 1
    print("候选 %s 获得票数 = %d" % (c, v))
    if v >= majority:
        print("%s 获得多数派(%d) -> 当选 leader, 执行故障转移" % (c, majority))
        leader = c
        break
print("最终 leader =", leader)
